name: Portland

neighborhoods.name: Parkside
neighborhoods.homes: older apartment buildings and multi-family houses

housing: Portland's rentals are mostly older wood-frame multi-family houses and triple-deckers, many split into apartments, plus condos.

localRules.text: Landlords must register their rental units with the City of Portland.
Portland has a voter-approved rent control ordinance that limits yearly rent increases on covered units.

tenantHelp.name: Pine Tree Legal Assistance
tenantHelp.what: free legal help for low-income tenants in Maine

climate: Test the heating, ask how it is fueled and look for drafts and ice-dam stains; winters are cold and snowy.
fact: Portland declares winter parking bans during snowstorms, so renters without off-street parking must move their cars.
